🚀 Find the New Logitech Products at TD SYNNEX! 👏

The next generation of Logitech collaboration technology has arrived and were excited to share that the new Rally Bar 2 is already available for live demos in our TD SYNNEX Canada offices!

Powered by advanced AI, Rally Bar 2 delivers exceptional video and audio performance while simplifying room deployments. But this launch goes beyond a single video bar. Logitech is expanding its portfolio with new intelligent cameras, advanced audio solutions, network-based connectivity, and innovative technologies designed to deliver incredible experiences in every meeting space. 

📅 Want to see it in action? Let's book a session and explore the new Rally Bar 2 and the latest Logitech innovations together in TD SYNNEX.
